scope: One fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind node and a dedicated Docker network attached only to that node and the fixture registry. A digest-pinned synthetic BusyBox image is pushed to a temporary authenticated loopback registry, pulled by kubelet into that node's cache, then challenged with imagePullPolicy Never under effective KubeletEnsureSecretPulledImages=true and AlwaysVerify. The no-identity Pod must remain container-free with ErrImageNeverPull; a Pod with the exact same synthetic registry identity must reuse the cached digest without registry manifest/blob access. Does not test provider configuration, rotation, revocation, multi-node behavior, preloaded images, or weaker policies.

checks.claim: The owned node does not already cache the exact seeded registry digest
Authenticated kubelet pull fetches and starts the exact pinned fixture
The exact immutable registry digest is present in the owned node cache
Strict cached-only request without the required synthetic identity stays container-free
The same authorized identity starts the exact cached digest without a registry pull
The case removes its temporary authenticated registry and bridge
